verdict.rationale: Docs only vaguely gesture at editing/iterating (e.g. 'Iterate on layouts, components, and experiences') without ever describing a direct code editor for the AI-generated code, while a hands-on community report describes local edits and Agent's own git operations locking files and conflicting to the point the user was locked out of editing and got no support (replit-comm-5); another user notes the editor itself has 'various bugs' (replit-comm-2). Missing for 10: explicit docs on the in-app code editor/file browser, screenshots or workflow docs showing manual edits to Agent-generated code, and independent confirmation that manual edits reliably coexist with Agent changes.
